mode.description: Global mode of operation: 'sslvnc' (SSL), 'sshvnc' (SSH), or 'sslvnc' (both). Default is sslvnc.

use_ssh.description: If true, attempts SSH tunneling by default.

use_ssl.description: If true, attempts SSL tunneling by default.

mycert.description: Path to the client's SSL certificate file (PEM format).

cacert.description: Path to the CA certificate file for verifying the server.

crl.description: Path to the Certificate Revocation List file.

font_default.description: Default font specification for the GUI text.

font_fixed.description: Default font specification for fixed-width GUI text.

port_knocking.description: Enable port knocking mechanism for SSH/SSL connections.

port_knock_sequence.description: Comma-separated list of ports to knock. Example: '1000,2000,3000'.

profiles.description: List of strings representing VNC connections in 'name=host:display' format.
